title: Hold a builder's licence
what: Hold the state's builder (or building contractor) licence or registration before contracting for or carrying out building work.

sources.title: Construction Occupations (Licensing) Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person— (a) provides a service (whether as an employee or otherwise) in a construction occupation or occupation class; and (b) either— (i) is not licensed in the occupation or class;
